moderation.afkWintradeThresholdNotice: Community AFK / Wintrade accounts are listed through user votes. Accounts with five or more votes receive an AFK tag. Automatically detected AFK accounts are shown separately.

moderation.boostedDescription: Players who party with confirmed cheaters.
moderation.boostedThresholdNotice: Players in a party with a cheater are automatically tracked. Players with five or more matches are flagged.
moderation.cheaterAssignmentNotice: Cheater tags are manually assigned after reviewing account activity, such as impossible statistics, or user reports of cheating, including video clips.
moderation.exploiterAssignmentNotice: A confirmed exploiter tag requires direct evidence. An impossible loading frame is flagged immediately; a removed (old) talent is flagged once it appears in 3 or more matches. The two checks are independent, so a frame hit tags a player even when they have fewer than 3 old-talent matches.

moderation.wallShooterNotice: A Wall Shooter flag is given to the losing lowest-damage Damage or Flank player when the next-lowest Damage or Flank dealt at least 67% more damage. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noWallShooters: No Wall Shooter flags match this search.
moderation.masterFeedingNotice: A Master Feeding flag requires a ranked loss with Master Riding, at least 8 deaths, KDA of 1.0 or below, and 25% more deaths than any other player. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noMasterFeeding: No Master Feeding flags match this search.
moderation.tankDiffDescription: Outstanding performances over the enemy Front Line.
moderation.tankDiffNotice: A Tank Diff flag requires a winning Front Line to lead the match in damage or kills and beat the strongest opposing Front Line by 25% in that stat. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noTankDiff: No Tank Diff flags match this search.
moderation.supportDiffDescription: Outstanding performances over the enemy Support.
moderation.supportDiffNotice: A Support Diff flag requires a winning Support to lead the match in healing, out-heal the opposing Support by 25%, and win despite the enemy holding the match's highest damage. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noSupportDiff: No Support Diff flags match this search.
moderation.dpsDiffDescription: Outstanding performances over the enemy Damage.
moderation.dpsDiffNotice: A DPS Diff flag requires a winning Damage player to lead the match in damage or kills and beat the opposing Damage player by 25% in that stat. The opposing team must lead a match stat. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noDpsDiff: No DPS Diff flags match this search.
moderation.flankDiffDescription: Outstanding performances over the enemy Flank.
moderation.flankDiffNotice: A Flank Diff flag requires a winning Flank to lead the match in damage or kills and beat the opposing Flank by 25% in that stat. The opposing team must lead a match stat. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noFlankDiff: No Flank Diff flags match this search.
moderation.noobDescription: Players who fell behind their team.
moderation.noobNotice: A Noob flag requires a winning Damage or Flank player to be the team's lowest-damage Damage or Flank, with both damage and kills at half or less of the team's leaders. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noNoobs: No Noob flags match this search.
moderation.hypercarryNotice: A Hypercarry flag requires a player to win with the match's highest damage and kills, at least 20% ahead of every other player in both. Surrendered lobbies and lobbies with a full-AFK player below 70 eCPM are excluded.
moderation.noHypercarries: No Hypercarry flags match this search.
moderation.dropperThresholdNotice: Dropper accounts are listed through user votes. Players with five or more votes receive a DROP tag.
moderation.communityMarkedAfkDescription: Community reports of AFK and win trading.
moderation.automaticAfkCriteria: At least 10 ranked matches showing extremely low activity.
moderation.afkSourceDescription: Each player appears once. Source badges distinguish community marks from automatic full-AFK match evidence.
moderation.noTrackedAfkPlayers: No community-marked or automatically flagged players found.
moderation.automaticAfkDetailDescription: Complete ranked matches where this player was automatically detected below the 70 eCPM full-AFK threshold.
